name: Unbridled Necromantic Energy (3-4)
description: Magical energy contained within the room surges in flashes of dark lightning.
disable: DC 20 Arcana (trained) to restore some of the arcane wards, DC 23 Religion or DC 23 Occultism (trained) to quell the necromantic energy in the room.

generalAbilities.name: Necromantic Discharge
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature steps into the room.

Effect The necromantic energy pulsing throughout the room branches out like lightning, inundating any creatures in the room or the three squares of hallway outside it. Each creature in those areas must attempt a DC 21 Fortitude Saving Throw save as they are suffused with dark energy, which deals (2d8+5) Void Damage damage, or (2d8+5) Vitality Damage damage to any creature with void healing.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and is Enfeebled 1 for 1 hour.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is enfeebled 1 for 1 hour.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is enfeebled 1 for 1 day.
